REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT Francisco Gold Condominium II EDSA Cor. Mapagmahal St., Diliman Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE BIVAHENG PINOY DIR. LILIBETH A. FAMACION, CESO IV OIC, Regional Director DILG, Region XIII 1559 Matimco Building, Libertad, Butuan City Dear Dir. Famacion: s. 2012 DILG Legal Opinion No JUL 16 ruE AND L RECORDS RELEASED SIGNATURE: DAYE'. TINE.' CONTROL NG. This pertains to your letter requesting this Department for opinion regarding item 9.2.c of the "Contract Implementation Guidelines for the Procurement of Infrastructure Projects", Annex "E" of Revised Implementing Rules and Regulations of RA 9184, which provides and we quote: "9. SUSPENSION OF WORK 9.2. The contractor or its duly authorized representative shall have the right to suspend work operation on any or all projects/activities along the critical path of activities after fifteen (15) calendar days from date or receipt of written notice from the contractor to the distinct engineer/regional director/consultant or equivalent official, as the case may be, due to the following: xxx xxx c. Peace and order condition make it extremely dangerous, if not possible, to work. However, this condition must be certified in writing by the Philippine National Police (PNP) station which has responsibility over the affected area and confirmed bv the Department of Interior_ Local Government (DILG) Regional Director. xxx xxx Per your letter, since this Department is a member of the Government Procurement Policy Board, hence, you would like to ask if the one referred to confirm is the Regional Director of DILG LG Sector or the Regional Director of the PNP which is also part of the DILG. In reply thereto, please be informed that the above-cited provisions clearly states that the certification issued by the PNP which has responsibility over the area which was declared that their peace and order conditions,

make it extremely dangerous, if not possible to work must be confirmed by the Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) Regional Director. Therefore, it is our considered view that it is the DILG Regional Director who will confirm the said certification issued by the PNP concerned and not the Regional Director of the PNP. With regard the extent of your confirmation, the same shall be based on the report/certification issued by the PNP as stated above and your evaluation/assessment from reports gathered by your own office to ascertain the veracity of the said report. Hope we have enlightened you on the matter. Very truly yours, US Dir LS:94/11 o or I
